enDef: the state of being able to do something

example.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
example.cn: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

cn: 能；[经管] 有能力的；能干的
enDef: clever or good at doing something

example.en: one of my more able students
example.cn: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

enDef: concerning or relating to a particular subject

example.en: a book about politics
example.cn: 一本有关政治的书

enDef: in a higher position than something else

example.en: Our office is above the hairdresser’s.
example.cn: 我们的办公室在理发店上面。

enDef: in or to a foreign country

example.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
example.cn: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

cn: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的
enDef: not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go

example.en: The dull, absent look on her face implied boredom.
example.cn: 她脸上呆滞、茫然的神情说明她觉得无聊了。

cn: 口音；重音；强调；特点；重音符号
enDef: the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from

example.en: He had a strong Irish accent
example.cn: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

cn: 接受；承认；承担；承兑；容纳
enDef: to take something that someone offers you, or to agree to do something that someone asks you to do

example.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
example.cn: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

cn: 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇
enDef: in a way that is not planned or intended

example.en: I met her quite by accident (=  completely by accident  ) .
example.cn: 我遇见她完全是偶然。

enDef: if part of your body aches, you feel a continuous, but not very sharp pain there

example.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
example.cn: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

enDef: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

example.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
example.cn: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

enDef: on the opposite side of something

example.en: We can gain some time if we cut across this field.
example.cn: 我们如果抄近路穿过这片田野可以省下一些时间。

enDef: to perform in a play or film

example.en: I first started acting when I was 12 years old.
example.cn: 我12岁开始演戏。

cn: 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节
enDef: the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing

example.en: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
example.cn: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

cn: 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的
enDef: always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities

example.en: games for active youngsters
example.cn: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

enDef: things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim

example.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
example.cn: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

enDef: to put something with something else or with a group of other things

example.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
example.cn: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

cn: 美洲（包括北美和南美洲）；美国

example.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
example.cn: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

cn: 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理
enDef: if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are sending it to

example.en: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
example.cn: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

enDef: a picture, set of words, or a short film, which is intended to persuade people to buy a product or use a service, or that gives information about a job that is available, an event that is going to happen etc

example.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
example.cn: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

enDef: an opinion you give someone about what they should do

example.en: You should have followed my advice.
example.cn: 你真该听我的建议。

cn: 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告
enDef: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something

example.en: She needed someone to advise her.
example.cn: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

enDef: to provide something or allow something to happen

example.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
example.cn: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

enDef: frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen

example.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
example.cn: 没有必要害怕。

enDef: After is also an adverb

example.en: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
example.cn: 明天。或者后天。

enDef: the part of the day after the morning and before the evening

example.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
example.cn: 星期四下午有个会议。

cn: 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加
enDef: one more time – used when something has happened or been done before

example.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
example.cn: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

enDef: next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support

example.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
example.cn: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

cn: 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段
enDef: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed

example.en: Francis is the same age as me.
example.cn: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

enDef: used to show how far back in the past something happened

example.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
example.cn: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

cn: 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定
enDef: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else

example.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
example.cn: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

enDef: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc

example.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
example.cn: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

cn: 空气，大气；天空；样子；曲调
enDef: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe

example.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
example.cn: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

enDef: a company that takes passengers and goods to different places by plane

example.en: an airline pilot
example.cn: 航空公司飞行员

enDef: a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines

example.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
example.cn: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

enDef: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in

example.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
example.cn: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

cn: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的
enDef: still living and not dead

example.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
example.cn: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

cn: 任何人； 随便哪一个人

enDef: completely

example.en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
example.cn: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

enDef: to let someone do or have something, or let something happen

example.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
example.cn: 泳池内禁止跳水。

enDef: nearly, but not completely or not quite

example.en: Have you almost finished?
example.cn: 你差不多完成了吗？

enDef: if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you

example.en: She lives alone .
example.cn: 她一个人生活。

enDef: going forward

example.en: I was driving along, thinking about Chris.
example.cn: 我一边开车，一边想着克里斯。

enDef: if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you

example.en: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
example.cn: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

enDef: before now, or before a particular time

example.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
example.cn: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

cn: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
enDef: used to say what event or activity someone is taking part in

example.en: I met my wife at a disco.
example.cn: 我在迪斯科舞会上认识了我的妻子。

enDef: in addition to something else that you have mentioned

example.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
example.cn: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

enDef: used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely

example.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
example.cn: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

enDef: all the time, at all times, or every time

example.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
example.cn: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

cn: 一，一个〔用于未曾提及或对方不知道的人或物的名称前〕
enDef: used to show that you are talking about someone or something that has not been mentioned before, or that your listener does not know about

example.en: We have a problem.
example.cn: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

cn: 美国人，美洲人；美国英语
enDef: someone from the US

example.en: The 1990 Nobel Prize for medicine was won by two Americans.
example.cn: 两名美国人获得了1990年度诺贝尔医学奖。

enDef: in or through the middle of a group of people or things

example.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
example.cn: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

cn: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的
enDef: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago

example.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
example.cn: 亚洲的古代文明

enDef: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way

example.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
example.cn: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

cn: 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的
enDef: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc

example.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
example.cn: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

enDef: a living creature such as a dog or cat, that is not an insect, plant, bird, fish, or person

example.en: furry little animals
example.cn: 毛茸茸的小动物

cn: 又一，另一；另外的；不同的

example.en: Can you cite another case like this one?
example.cn: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

enDef: to say something to someone as a reply when they have asked you a question, made a suggestion etc

example.en: She thought for a moment before answering.
example.cn: 她想了一会儿才回答。

enDef: a small insect that lives in large groups

example.en: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
example.cn: 蚂蚁从地里成群地爬出来，爬满了她的鞋和腿。

cn: 苹果，苹果树，苹果似的东西；[美俚]炸弹，手榴弹，（棒球的）球；[美俚]人，家伙。
enDef: a hard round fruit that has red, light green, or yellow skin and is white inside

example.en: apple pie
example.cn: 苹果馅饼

example.en: We should be prepared for any contingency.
example.cn: 我们应该对任何应急情况有所准备。

enDef: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who

example.en: Anyone could win tonight.
example.cn: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

enDef: any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which

example.en: You can buy anything you want.
example.cn: 你想要什么都可以买。

cn: 无论如何，不管怎样；总之
enDef: in spite of the fact that you have just mentioned

example.en: Catherine wasn’t sure the book was the right one, but she bought it anyway.
example.cn: 凯瑟琳不能确定就是这本书，但她还是买了。

enDef: in or to any place

example.en: Sit anywhere you like.
example.cn: 你随便坐吧。

cn: 出现；显得；似乎；出庭；登场
enDef: used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see

example.en: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
example.cn: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

enDef: the fourth month of the year, between March and May

example.en: The changes will be introduced in April.
example.cn: 这些变更将于4月实施。

enDef: a particular part of a country, town etc

example.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
example.cn: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

cn: 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门
enDef: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands

example.en: Dave has a broken arm .
example.cn: 戴夫手臂断了。

enDef: the part of a country’s military force that is trained to fight on land in a war

example.en: The army are helping to clear up after the floods.
example.cn: 陆军部队正协助洪灾后的清理工作。

enDef: in or to many places or parts of an area

example.en: He wandered around the streets, looking in shop windows.
example.cn: 他在街上闲逛，看看商店橱窗。

enDef: to get to the place you are going to

example.en: Give me a call to let me know you’ve arrived safely.
example.cn: 打个电话给我，告诉我你已平安到达。

enDef: the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas

example.en: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
example.cn: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

cn: 文章；物品；条款；[语] 冠词
enDef: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine

example.en: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
example.cn: 该报社论称政府软弱。

cn: 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时
enDef: while or when

example.en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
example.cn: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

example.en: The European powers extended their authority in Asia.
example.cn: 欧洲列强在亚洲扩大他们的管辖权。

enDef: someone from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia, especially India or Pakistan

example.en: Many of the shops were run by Asians.
example.cn: 这些商店中有许多是由亚洲人经营的。

cn: 问，询问；要求；需要；邀请；讨价
enDef: to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution

example.en: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
example.cn: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

enDef: sleeping

example.en: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
example.cn: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

example.en: They underlaid the Atlantic with a cable.
example.cn: 他们在大西洋海底铺设了一条电缆。

enDef: when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something

example.en: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
example.cn: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

enDef: the eighth month of the year, between July and September

example.en: The world premiere took place in August 1956.
example.cn: 全球首映是在1956年8月。

enDef: the sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your father’s or mother’s brother

example.en: Aunt Mary
example.cn: 玛丽姑妈

example.en: He transplanted his family to Australia.
example.cn: 他把家迁到澳大利亚。

cn: 澳大利亚的，澳大利亚人的
enDef: relating to Australia or its people

example.en: She went solo backpacking for eight months in the Australian outback.
example.cn: 她在澳大利亚内陆独自背包旅行了八个月。

cn: 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期
enDef: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes cooler

example.en: autumn mists
example.cn: 秋天的雾霭

cn: 可获得的；可购得的；可找到的；有空的
enDef: something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found

example.en: Tickets are available from the box office.
example.cn: 售票处有票出售。

enDef: the power you have because of your official position

example.en: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
example.cn: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

enDef: to prevent something bad from happening

example.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
example.cn: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

enDef: used to say that someone leaves a place or person, or stays some distance from a place or person

example.en: Go away!
example.cn: 走开！

example.en: Caretaker: You are alright?
example.cn: 看守人：你还好吧？

example.en: Can you tell us something about your experiences in Africa?
example.cn: 你能告诉我们一些有关你在非洲的经历吗？

cn: 再， 更， 还； 目前， 现在， 今后
enDef: not any longer

example.en: Nick doesn’t live here anymore.
example.cn: 尼克不再住在这里了。

cn: 林荫道； 道路， 大街
enDef: used in the names of streets in a town or city

example.en: Fifth Avenue
example.cn: 第五大街

cn: 艺术家， 画家； 能手
enDef: someone who produces art, especially paintings or drawings

example.en: an exhibition of paintings by local artists
example.cn: 当地画家的画展

cn: 外国的；外星的；陌生的；格格不入的
enDef: very different from what you are used to, especially in a way that is difficult to understand or accept

example.en: the alien environment of the city
example.cn: 城里陌生的环境

cn: 约会； 约定； 任命， 委派； 职务， 职位
enDef: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose

example.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
example.cn: 就诊必须预约。

cn: 发育成熟的； 成熟的， 成人的
enDef: fully grown or developed

example.en: an adult lion
example.cn: 一头成年的狮子

cn: 态度； 看法， 意见
enDef: the opinions and feelings that you usually have about something, especially when this is shown in your behaviour

example.en: As soon as they found out I was a doctor, their whole attitude changed.
example.cn: 他们一听说我是医生，态度就完全改变了。

enDef: a word that adds to the meaning of a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, such as ‘slowly’ in ‘He ran slowly’, ‘very’ in ‘It’s very hot’, or ‘naturally’ in ‘Naturally, we want you to come.’

example.en: An adverbial is often one word, an adverb.
example.cn: 状语经常只是一个副词。例如。

cn: 尝试， 企图； 努力
enDef: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult

example.en: He made no attempt to hide his anger.
example.cn: 他毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

cn: 协会， 联盟， 社团； 联合， 结合
enDef: an organization that consists of a group of people who have the same aims, do the same kind of work etc

example.en: the Association of Master Builders
example.cn: 建筑师协会

cn: 代理人， 代理商， 经纪人
enDef: a person or company that represents another person or company, especially in business

example.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
example.cn: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

cn: 伴随的， 随之而产生的
enDef: relating to or caused by something

example.en: a car park attendant
example.cn: 停车场的服务员

cn: 优点， 好处， 优势
enDef: a good or useful feature that something has

example.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
example.cn: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

enDef: Assistant is used in front of titles or jobs to indicate a slightly lower rank. For example, an assistant director is one rank lower than a director in an organization.

example.en: ...the assistant secretary of defence.
example.cn: …助理国防部长。

cn: 极坏的； 糟糕的， 令人不快的； 可怕的； 非常的
enDef: very bad or unpleasant

example.en: The weather was awful.
example.cn: 天气很糟糕。

cn: 侵犯的， 侵略的， 挑衅的； 敢作敢为的， 有进取心的
enDef: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone

example.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
example.cn: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

enDef: to help someone do something

example.en: an index to aid the reader
example.cn: 方便读者的索引

cn: 瞄准， 对准； 目的是， 旨在； 针对； 力争做到
enDef: to try or intend to achieve something

example.en: a program that’s aimed at teenagers
example.cn: 对象为青少年的节目

cn: 焦虑的， 发愁的， 令人焦急的； 渴望的， 急
enDef: worried about something

example.en: She gave me an anxious look.
example.cn: 她焦急地看了我一眼。

enDef: if a famous person autographs a book, photograph etc, they sign it

example.en: a shirt autographed by the whole team
example.cn: 一件有全体队员签名的衬衫

enDef: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total

example.en: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to $9.75 billion.
example.cn: 消费者在体育相关用品上的消费总共达到了97.5亿美元。

cn: 粘贴簿； 集邮簿； 相册； 音乐专辑
enDef: a group of songs or pieces of music on a  CD  , tape etc

example.en: The band plan to release their new album next week.
example.cn: 该乐队计划下周发行他们的新专辑。

enDef: not sleeping

example.en: I hope he’s awake now.
example.cn: 我希望他现在醒着。

enDef: the first person singular of the present tense of the verb  be

cn: 一（个）〔用于以元音开头的单词前〕
enDef: used when the following word begins with a vowel sound

example.en: an orange
example.cn: 一个橘子

cn: 宣布， 声称； 预告
enDef: to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision

example.en: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
example.cn: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

cn: 作家， 作者； 创始人， 发起者

example.en: Nothomb is a Belgian author.
example.cn: 诺东是位比利时作家。

example.en: He’s an amazing player to watch.
example.cn: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

enDef: to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way

example.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
example.cn: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

cn: 附件， 零件， 配件； 装饰品
enDef: something such as a piece of equipment or a decoration that is not necessary, but that makes a machine, car, room etc more useful or more attractive

example.cn: 镜子和毛巾架等浴室配件

enDef: to officially give someone something such as a prize or money to reward them for something they have done

example.en: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
example.cn: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

enDef: if someone does something with abandon, they behave in a careless or uncontrolled way, without thinking or caring about what they are doing

example.en: He approached life with reckless abandon–I don't think he himself knew what he was going to do next.
example.cn: 他以不计后果的放纵态度对待生活–我想他自己都不知道他接下来要做什么。

cn: 反常的，不规则的；变态的
enDef: very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous

example.en: abnormal behaviour
example.cn: 反常行为

enDef: to examine or think about something carefully, in order to understand it

example.en: She still needs to analyse the data.
example.cn: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

cn: 在飞机上；[船] 在船上；在火车上
enDef: on or onto a ship, plane, or train

example.en: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
example.cn: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

enDef: sudden and unexpected

example.en: an abrupt change of plan
example.cn: 计划的突然改变

enDef: to officially end a law, system etc, especially one that has existed for a long time

example.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
example.cn: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

cn: 流产，堕胎，小产；流产的胎儿；（计划等）失败，夭折
enDef: a medical operation to end a  pregnancy  so that the baby is not born alive

example.en: She decided to have an abortion .
example.cn: 她决定做人工流产。

enDef: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation

example.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
example.cn: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

enDef: when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away

example.en: In the absence of any evidence, the police had to let Myers go.
example.cn: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

enDef: complete or total

example.en: I have absolute confidence in her.
example.cn: 我对她充满信心。

enDef: to take in liquid, gas, or another substance from the surface or space around something

example.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
example.cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

enDef: a painting, design etc which contains shapes or images that do not look like real things or people

example.en: Talking about crime in the abstract just isn’t enough.
example.cn: 抽象地谈论犯罪根本不足以说明问题。

enDef: completely stupid or unreasonable

example.en: It seems an absurd idea.
example.cn: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

example.cn: 充足的淡水供应

example.cn: 他没有学历。

example.cn: 美国艺术和文学学会

enDef: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect

example.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
example.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

enDef: a group of people who come to watch and listen to someone speaking or performing in public

example.en: The audience began clapping and cheering.
example.cn: 观众开始鼓掌欢呼。

enDef: to find information, especially on a computer

example.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
example.cn: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

enDef: a place, building, or object that is accessible is easy to reach or get into

example.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
example.cn: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

cn: 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播

example.cn: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

cn: 住处，膳宿；调节；和解；预订铺位
enDef: a place for someone to stay, live, or work

example.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
example.cn: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

enDef: to go somewhere with someone

example.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
example.cn: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

enDef: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard

example.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
example.cn: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

enDef: something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts

example.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
example.cn: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

cn: 账户；解释；账目，账单；理由；描述
enDef: an arrangement in which a bank keeps your money safe so that you can pay more in or take money out

example.en: My salary is paid into my bank account.
example.cn: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

enDef: a process in which a doctor makes someone talk about their past experiences, relationships etc in order to help them with mental or emotional problems

example.en: She’s been in analysis for three years.
example.cn: 她接受精神分析治疗已经三年了。

enDef: someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc

example.en: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
example.cn: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

enDef: to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time

example.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
example.cn: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

enDef: easy to notice

example.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
example.cn: 质量的差异显而易见。

enDef: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake

example.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
example.cn: 他传球准确无误。

enDef: to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad

example.cn: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

enDef: usual

example.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
example.cn: 那些锅在老地方。

example.en: sulphuric acid
example.cn: 硫酸

example.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
example.cn: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

cn: 承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到

example.cn: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

enDef: someone you know, but who is not a close friend

example.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
example.cn: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

enDef: to obtain something by buying it or being given it

example.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
example.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

enDef: the process by which you gain knowledge or learn a skill

example.en: the acquisition of language
example.cn: 语言的习得

enDef: a unit for measuring area, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,047 square metres

example.cn: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

enDef: a short distance in front of someone or something

example.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
example.cn: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

enDef: someone who performs in a play or film

example.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
example.cn: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

enDef: a woman who performs in a play or film

example.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
example.cn: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

cn: 真实的，实际的；现行的，目前的

example.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
example.cn: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

example.cn: 住房短缺情况比一开始想的要严重。

cn: 适应；改编；改编本，改写本

example.cn: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

example.cn: 这些妇女中的很多吸食海洛因和可卡因成瘾。

cn: 添加；[数] 加法；增加物

example.cn: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

example.cn: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

example.cn: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

example.cn: 一段调整期

example.cn: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

cn: 令人钦佩的；极好的；值得赞扬的

example.cn: 令人钦佩的成就

example.cn: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

cn: 承认；入场费；进入许可；坦白；录用

example.cn: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

example.cn: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

example.cn: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

example.cn: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

example.cn: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

enDef: a change, discovery, or  invention  that brings progress

example.en: a major advance
example.cn: 一项重大进展

example.cn: 从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。

example.cn: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

example.cn: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

example.cn: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

example.cn: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

enDef: to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation

example.cn: 受飓风影响的地区

enDef: a feeling of liking or love and caring

example.cn: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

example.cn: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

enDef: relating to Africa or its people

example.cn: …非洲大陆。

example.cn: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

example.cn: 为生存而挣扎的农民们把森林伐光来作农业用地。

example.cn: 拼图能让埃米连续玩上几个小时。

example.cn: 加拿大领空

example.cn: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

enDef: relating to alcohol or containing alcohol

example.cn: 酒精饮料

cn: 焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事

example.en: his feelings of anxiety
example.cn: 他焦虑的心情

enDef: a type of mathematics that uses letters and other signs to represent numbers and values

example.cn: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

example.cn: 这条小巷通往铁路桥。

enDef: something that is added or joined to something that is bigger or more important

cn: 无私的， 为他人着想的
enDef: altruistic behaviour shows that you care about and will help other people, even though this brings no advantage for yourself

example.en: Were his motives entirely altruistic?
example.cn: 他的动机是完全无私的吗？

enDef: An alchemist was a scientist in the Middle Ages who tried to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold

example.en: Would you rather be an alchemist or a chemist?
example.cn: 那么，你想做一个炼金术士，还是一个化学家呢？

enDef: a medical condition that causes difficulties in breathing

example.en: Any illness of the lungs or throat , such as asthma or a cough.
example.cn: 消耗病，痨病肺部或喉咙的任何一种病变，如哮喘或咳嗽。

cn: 在野外， 在田中； 在战场上； 离乡背井地； 到远方， 在远处
enDef: far away, especially from home

example.en: They were exporting as far afield as Alexandria.
example.cn: 他们出口货物远至亚历山德里亚。

cn: 轶话的， 轶闻趣事的
enDef: consisting of short stories based on someone’s personal experience

example.en: His findings are based on anecdotal evidence rather than serious research.
example.cn: 他的发现依据的是传闻轶事，而不是认真的调查研究。

cn: 配给， 分配， 安置； 配给量
enDef: the amount or share of something that has been allocated for a particular purpose

example.en: Twelve hours a week seemed a generous allocation of your time.
example.cn: 一周12个小时，这好像占用了你很多时间。
